independent_review.text:
# Independent review: post-common menu successors

The three bounded source/receipt successors are supported at exact base fdcdadee28c4552e3500b5099de9f42e456adb5c. They do not establish global source authority, G02/G11, full C04 admission, a current browser run or release readiness. Frozen manifest SHA-256 464e53388e495d714360bb7be9fea6c92dd2fa4bc6ba4a590e5c1f4145518a9e. Each patch applies strictly with `--whitespace=error` to a private index, and all 15 resulting changed/new paths independently match the frozen candidate bytes:

* motion-final.patch SHA-256 f9dce938fbe369386bfba1d890a61c6ec30263a599a2ea488e562baa5eedb748, tree 6b0545c1d96947e4726799dbf7ca29494218a0fd;
* eight-final.patch SHA-256 924b05f5bfe64e8c2600fad0d3baa9bd5079f40575b596559b80b7fcb8d71aa3, tree 0bb3b0ea6da56b6b78c7b58f60bfd27f664271c7;
* caller-final.patch SHA-256 04d04ca430cf460e6cba12af337ce4b59975745f874574f2f08038e1feab524e, tree 0fbd40fcda0f1e134d34f6c7311b53067913320d.

The eight ledger decisions retain their full prior rows, complete predecessor reviews, dispositions and full upstream diff bytes. Only three of each decision's 28 source members changed: the menu and core public barrels and menu module. The full embedded source delta exactly matches the actual Git diff from the original 4c29 menu review to fdcd. The owned common module remains the same class imported under its historical legacy name; 4b accurately distinguishes the locally retained internal scroll factory/provider from the removed primary aliases. All 28 current source members match exact fdcd bytes. Independent TypeScript JSON-AST comparison finds the original 1,697 ledger row order preserved and raw bytes outside the targeted eight rows unchanged.

I exercised the unchanged actual production dispatcher against the frozen fdcd base in an existing isolated worktree: its insufficient/evidence SHA union changed 831→823 by exactly the targeted eight, with none added; separately corrupting a source file, each retained upstream diff, or branch bindings reopened all eight. All aggregate CLI invocations exited 1 because unrelated obligations remain. `eight-cli-state.json` SHA-256 328d6c18f6a25f9d2ba84a7962c2b0b8c6a0b2df218bb15f9fefbbcc500685ee. Prior bdc/b5df browser observations are still historical and were not rerun or reattributed to fdcd.

The menu motion record retains the complete f4 predecessor and unchanged older constructor proof. I verified the seven fdcd source hashes, actual producer/output byte identities and independently rehashed 2828 tar. All 512 installed package files matched that tar; the observed menu and core FESM hashes match the packed members. I reran the actual packed public-subclass motion observer in its synthetic Angular server environment: nine finite cases, four classified requests, foreign-export and altered-prototype negatives passed, with exact same output hash as retained. The maintained motion suite passed 4/4; independently replacing the producer and clearing source members with a coherently rehashed embedded value was rejected by the externally pinned receipt. This is source/test-level proof at its named artifact epoch, not a full production-source authority frame or native browser result.

The 17-row caller capture preserves every complete historical record, binds actual fdcd source and observed public/owned token roles, and remains a non-admitting source review. I independently verified 52 source hashes and six retained producer/output bytes, reproduced the source-capture generator byte-for-byte, and reran its maintained test successfully. Its independently pinned integration record contains the 2828 artifact hash; coherently altered capture data was rejected by the fixed receipt identity. The emitted JIT source observations and Angular synthetic injector are not generated-query, native/browser or AOT equivalence evidence.

Identity hashes do not establish semantic correctness without the substantive review. The common-source changes do not justify rewriting historical observations; linked dependencies were not independently closure-frozen. No canonical writes or installations were performed.
